'''R4-A22''' was an orange [[R4 astromech droid/Legends|R4 astromech droid]] who worked at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
R4-A22 was made into into an action figure in [[2006]] when it was included in the "Entertainment Earth" droid pack that included other astromech droids from the movie series.
